1.Name: Orb of Concentration
1.Des:
This orb constantly draws in power, making its wielder stronger over time... that is, if they can survive until it fully awakens.
(For plant-transforming monsters)

2.Name: Silvertooth Spinblade
2.Des:
Once a finely crafted weapon of the aristocracy, sharp enough to slice through the toughest armor... It was later repurposed to trim the appetite of certain insatiable monsters.
(For flying monsters)

3.Name: Ring of Calmness
3.Des:
Grants total immunity to mind control, making its wearer's willpower as unshakable as a rock. It's said that those who wear it can finally resist the urge to applaud at leadership's brainwashing meetings...
(For hooded monsters)

4.Name: Helm of Silence
4.Des:
Not only does this protect against magic-infused sonic attacks, but it also blocks out meaningless corporate jargon... and even silences the ominous late-night whisper of "That deadline is first thing in the morning."
(For monsters with facial marks)

5.Name: Froststar Bell
5.Des:
A relic left behind by a legendary sage, capable of snuffing out flames of evil with a single ring... though it also wipes out nearby fires in the process.
(For wild, untamed monsters)

6.Name: Pocket-Watch of Time
6.Des:
Time flows endlessly within this mysterious pocket watch. Legends claim its owner can ever so slightly adjust the passage of time... but no matter how hard they try, their paycheck won't arrive any earlier.
(For shield-wielding Graveborn monsters)

7.Name: Ethereal Candle
7.Des:
Casts an obscuring light that hides the wielder from sight. Once used for stealth and secret rites, these days, it's mostly used for slipping away at clock-out...
(For red-eyed warrior monsters)

8.Name: Blazing Crystal
8.Des:
This crystal core burns with an undying flame, keeping its wielder warm... and making certain cold-blooded, emotionless beings extremely uncomfortable.
(For Graveborn monsters with horned helmets)

101.Name: Draconic Horn
101.Des: This horn once belonged to some kind of majestic creature. It still shows signs of its tattered greatness.

102.Name: Shattered Pearl
102.Des: It used to show the future in its reflections, but only cracks remain.

103.Name: Arcane Accord
103.Des: It promises great power, but the price is unending exhaustion.

104.Name: Resonant Bell
104.Des: Broken as it is, it still emits a faint echo.

105.Name: Eternal Leaf
105.Des: Every time it burns to ashes, it allows you to hold out another day.

106.Name: Forbidden Talisman
106.Des: It's not some forbidden power that is sealed away, but freedom.

107.Name: Eternal Pillar
107.Des: Symbolizing unwavering faith, its protective power has endured through the ages.

108.Name: Remnant Core
108.Des: Never allow a shutdown until all the energy is exhausted.

201.Name: Wicked Eye
201.Des: The Hypogean eye that stares into the abyss—nothing escapes its gaze.

202.Name: Iron Arrowhead
202.Des: Having endured countless battles, it is marred but as keen as ever.

203.Name: Soulbound Bow
203.Des: A bow of bone imbued with some kind of spirit. Pity it doesn't have auto-aim.

204.Name: Mysterious Locks
204.Des: Whatever you do, this tuft of hair manages to stick to you...

205.Name: Sunset Blossom
205.Des: As the sun sets in the west, blooming is best left for tomorrow.

206.Name: Mystic Cinders
206.Des: Some say it's a mystical substance of a golden age, while others say it's a relic of a dream reduced to ashes.

207.Name: Unyielding Banner
207.Des: While this flag still flaps in the wind, the warrior's fighting spirit will never break.

208.Name: Golem Remnant
208.Des: This golem held out for so long, yet crumbled in the end.

301.Name: Sinister Eye
301.Des: Its pupil ever watchful, it brings only ineffable unease.

302.Name: Corroded Arrowhead
302.Des: Amidst the splotches of rust, its edge retains a certain sharpness.

303.Name: Withered Bow
303.Des: Crafted from the bones of some unknown monster, its bowstring is exceedingly taut.

304.Name: Abandoned Locks
304.Des: Is this some lost keepsake, or a testament to weariness?

305.Name: Daybreak Blossom
305.Des: As the morning dew lies yet undisturbed, even flowers refuse to bloom.

306.Name: Shimmering Cinders
306.Des: All that remains of a searing passion is a handful of ashes.

307.Name: Oathbound Banner
307.Des: The vow to fight to the death still flutters, just as the will to protect wavers not.

308.Name: Residual Fragment
308.Des: The shattered stone retains a faint magical residue.
